name: lingsante-3.1-air-vl
description:
We are officially introducing LingSante-3.1-air-VL, a lightweight native multimodal model designed for real-world healthcare applications. Built on Ling-3.0-flash-VL, it has 124B total parameters with only 5.5B activated during inference. It natively supports text, image, and video inputs and a context window of up to 256K tokens, balancing medical multimodal understanding, medical text reasoning, and deployment efficiency.

Ling-3.1-air-VL-Sante excels in core medical scenarios. It ranks first on imaging report evaluations including CheXpert_Plus, IU_XRAY, and mimic_cxr, and first overall on application-specific evaluations involving photos of skin, food, and medical reports. It also ranks first on medical multimodal benchmarks including OmniMedVQA, PATH-VQA, and SLAKE, and places in the top tier on complex reasoning benchmarks such as MedXpertQA-MM, while delivering strong medical text capabilities. Beyond healthcare, the model maintains strong performance in general multimodal tasks, document and chart understanding, and tool-based tasks such as multimodal search and GUI agents—extending its capabilities from understanding to explanation and action.
zhDescription:
我们正式推出 LingSante-3.1-air-VL，这是一款面向真实医疗场景的轻量级原生多模态模型。模型基于 Ling-3.0-flash-VL 构建，总参数 124B，单次推理仅激活 5.5B，原生支持文本、图像与视频输入，上下文窗口最高 256K Token，在医疗多模理解、医疗文本推理和部署效率之间取得平衡。
Ling-3.1-air-VL-Sante 在核心医疗场景中表现突出：CheXpert_Plus、IU_XRAY、mimic_cxr 等影像报告评测均位列第一；拍皮肤、拍食物、拍医疗报告等业务评测整体位列第一；OmniMedVQA、PATH-VQA、SLAKE 等医疗多模态评测位列第一，MedXpertQA-MM 等复杂推理评测进入第一梯队；医疗文本能力同样表现优异。除医疗外，模型在通用多模、文档/图表理解，以及多模态搜索、GUI Agent 等工具类任务上保持强劲表现，能够从“看懂”进一步走向“解释”和“操作”。
